reviewerRole: Independent visual critic; no asset or scene authoring
scope: Blender full-source versus rebaked runtime comparison only
comparison: The rejected crate-v3-runtime front and back comparisons were reviewed previously. The v4 front image has full source at left and runtime at right; the back image reverses those positions.
verdict: Pass for native audition. The conspicuous v3 texture-mapping regression is corrected in the reviewed views.
observations: The rear-face white bars now remain straight painted marks with source-like wear; the triangular zigzags that rejected v3 are absent.
The A7 mark, smaller handle-side stencils and shipping label retain their recognizable shapes without the previous angular displacements.
The case silhouette, lid seam, recessed handle, corner guards, straps and fasteners remain coherent. No new black puncture, obvious bake seam or large projection leak is visible in these comparisons.

The lid's pale marking and dented metal remain broadly comparable to the source. Differences in highlight brightness alone cannot establish a material regression because the objects occupy different positions relative to the review lights.
remainingConcerns: Some small side-panel relief and wear look slightly softer in the runtime. Check the native normal map, mip selection and intended closest view before accepting the material detail.
Inspect the lid dent and seam, handhold interior and thin strap edges from low oblique native angles so projection errors or backface problems are not hidden by these two views.
Keep the source's shallow transport-case proportions with uniform scale. Verify orientation, human scale and base contact at the actual audition location.

The background reference street and original crate have different proportions and weathering. A plausible new case can be acceptable, but these source stills cannot establish its integration with the street.

matchedPositionSupplement.finding: The matched camera and lighting views confirm source-like lid brightness, preserved stencil shapes and comparable side-panel relief. No additional conspicuous projection or mapping defect is visible. The earlier broad highlight difference is attributable to the comparison setup rather than a confirmed material error. Native close-up and moving review remain required.

acceptance: Suitable for controlled native audition. Ground contact, native sun and shade, motion stability, runtime cost and final AAA street acceptance remain unassessed.
